game_concept: A programming puzzle set in The Kingdom – Orchard Lane, the royal orchard lane: the knight must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Uninitialized Hunt: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before thieves exploit the gap.
theme: The Kingdom – Orchard Lane: the royal orchard lane
core_gameplay_loop: In Orchard Lane, repeat each round: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before thieves exploit the gap. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the bugs_fixed value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the royal seal using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The royal seal reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the royal seal is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Uninitialized Hunt
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Uninitialized Hunt' (Week 1 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Orchard Lane'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bugs_fixed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Orchard Lane.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The royal seal reached with actions_used <= 14.
